description: This file defines the LocalizationPartDisplayDriver class, which manages the display, editing, and updating of LocalizationPart content items within OrchardCore CMS. It handles localization data, builds view models, and interacts with localization services.

classes.name: LocalizationPartDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver for LocalizationPart, managing its display, editing, and update logic within OrchardCore.

methods.name: Display
methods.description: Returns the display result for a LocalizationPart, including summary and admin links.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Returns the editor shape for a LocalizationPart.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Handles asynchronous update of LocalizationPart data from the editor form.

methods.name: BuildViewModelAsync
methods.description: Builds the view model for a LocalizationPart, including supported cultures and existing translations.
